dreamteamer.description: What a workspace builds and investigates: `products`, their `design-docs`, `implementation-plans`, `user-stories`, `screens`, `prototypes`, `design-systems` and `tests`; `reviews` and their `review-findings`; `features` and `issues` per repo; `research-docs`, `open-questions`, `experiments`, `draft-docs`; `personas` scored against `persona-probes`; `references` to model on.
